claim: For any odd root u whose shortcut orbit is injective, every b < 1/clockDrift + actualFirstHitDensity u/(wholeOrbitCorrection u*log(3/2)) is eventually at most the odd-target actual-density sum divided by log R. The extra coefficient is positive when u is a unit modulo three.
